integrity: Self-contained analytic argument and reproducible diagnostic script; numerical checks are not an infinite proof. Literature comparison is provisional and independent evaluation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Unbounded deterministic exponential early growth, independent Poisson-type survey detections, fixed founding phase and exactly periodic surveys. Carrying capacity, phase-uncertain starts, correlated surveys and field calibration are not established. A closely relevant 2012 paper and a later size-at-detection article were not inspected in full.
title: A nonvanishing logarithmic-phase correction to discovery size under periodic invasion surveillance
